standard-dialogue.npc: Greetings, stranger. How can I help you?

steps.npc: It's a cave filled with araxytes, a rare form of arachnid. I've been here researching them for some time.

steps.text: If the player has not completed Monkey Madness II:

steps.npc: My niece, Nieve, is one of those Slayer Masters. You know, they tell people what to go kill. I also look after this cave for people on assignments like that.

steps.text: If the player has completed Monkey Madness II:

steps.npc: My nephew, Steve, is one of those Slayer Masters. You know, they tell people what to go kill. I also look after this cave for people on assignments like that.
However, the araxytes here are rather venomous... and when I say venomous, I mean venomous.
Well, I didn't think so by itself, but lots of other people seem to find it very interesting.
For example, there were some particularly pale wanderers doing their own research in here. They didn't bother me though.

using-a-jar-of-venom-on-her.text: If the player is using it on her for the first time:

steps.player: I found this Jar, I think it's full of venom.

steps.npc: Oh wow, can I see it?.

steps.text: You show Weave the Jar of Venom.

steps.npc: That is really fascinating. Thank you for sharing that with me.
Next I'll need to find something a little more potent to progress my research...

using-a-jar-of-venom-on-her.text: If the player is using it on her again:

steps.player: Did you want to see the Jar again?

steps.npc: No that's quite alright, I've nothing else to learn from that particular sample. I need to find something else to progress my research...

when-attempting-to-kill-monsters-that-ar.npc: Bad! Don't touch these unless you have a Slayer task to kill them.
